description:
Amendment 0005 to RFQ 36C25526Q0617 provides supplemental questions and responses and extends the quotation deadline from November 20, 2026, to November 27, 2026, at 3:00 PM Central Standard Time (CST). The amendment identifies the site-visit attendee, updates a door identifier, clarifies infection-control review and permit responsibilities, and provides the VHA infection-control risk assessment matrix. It also states that work-area restrictions will be addressed at the time of award; existing personnel-vetting and access-approval requirements remain unchanged. Submit quotations by email to michael.murphy7@va.gov. Offerors may revise previously submitted quotations before the new deadline and must acknowledge this amendment and all prior amendments. Existing submission and volume/file requirements remain unchanged. Review the SF 30, continuation and attachments for the complete changes, responses and remaining deferred matters. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged.
